title: OS Window Chrome Layout Fix
description: Migrate the raw-wgpu OS/playground stack from browser-only wasm-bindgen/web-sys to winit windowing/input (native + web) and trunk build tooling, plus native hot-swappable plugin hosting.
summary: Polished OS window chrome fills and U-cutout stroke: caps and gap now use semio-chrome-canvas with full titlebar-height fills (not window-colored text-sized strips), gap bottom rule matches exact gap width without kern extension, removed body overlap that hid the U bottom stroke, and unified body frame to boxrule hairlines consistent with header \rule strokes.
